basis: The visual evidence from the chart shows that at the 2012.0 x-position, the red square marker (representing Canada) is positioned vertically higher than the blue circle marker (representing United States). While the chart uses separate y-axes for each country, the routing criterion is defined as the 'Larger 2012 country indicator value shown in the dashboard'. In the context of a dashboard display, the relative vertical position of the markers is the primary visual indicator of the 'larger' value as presented. Since the Canada marker is higher than the United States marker in 2012, Canada is the country with the larger value shown.
